recognize_zh: 高倍下萎縮的生發中心內充滿粉紅色透明化物質與少量濾泡樹突細胞，一條透明化血管從下方斜向穿入，周圍小淋巴球一層層包繞，這種血管穿入萎縮生發中心加上層狀外套區就是透明血管型 Castleman 病的特徵。
features: Atretic germinal center composed of hyalinized eosinophilic deposits and scattered follicular dendritic/endothelial cells
Hyalinized vessel with plump endothelial cells penetrating obliquely into the germinal center
Surrounding mantle zone of small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm arranged in layers
Lymphocytes are monotonous-appearing but cytologically bland without atypia
No mitotic activity, necrosis or large atypical cells evident
describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node follicle shows a markedly atretic germinal center replaced by hyalinized eosinophilic material with scattered follicular dendritic and endothelial cells. A hyalinized vessel penetrates the germinal center from the periphery. The surrounding mantle zone is composed of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei, arranged in a layered fashion. There are no atypical large cells or mitotic figures. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have slightly irregular nuclei and are CD5/cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with light-chain restriction, while Castleman mantle lymphocytes are polyclonal IgD-positive and cyclin D1-negative.
HIV lymphadenitis shows follicle lysis and depletion with plasmacytosis in an appropriate clinical context rather than uniformly broad concentric mantles around multiple atretic centers.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell or HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Those variants show sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, and HHV8-associated disease has LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone, which are not evident in this field.
